title: What's a food that you had at the Food Court?
content: This dream was last year. My parents, both of who passed away, took me here so they could spend some time with me. While there? My Dad insisted I have a pork and broccoli rabe sandwich, a food I never had or even was interested in trying, and I loved it! I have them regularly now. There were also bags of blue and pink cotton candy but I didn't try those.
